title: Evidence Added while a Safety Recall Stands on a Keyturn Vehicle Listing
content:
An open safety recall on a Keyturn Vehicle Listing is read off two things standing on the vehicle's condition record: whether a fault report registering an open recall stands there at all, and whether a recall clearance document has been verified on that record.

- A vehicle carrying an open recall fault report on its condition record with no recall clearance document verified there adds 3 photographs.
- A vehicle carrying an open recall fault report with a recall clearance document verified adds 1 photograph.
- A vehicle carrying no open recall fault report adds nothing on this ground, an addition of 0 photographs.

### The same rule as the questions it answers

*The vehicle has one open recall fault report and no clearance on the record.* The first clause governs and 3 photographs are added.

*The vehicle has one open recall fault report and a verified recall clearance.* The second clause governs and 1 photograph is added; the clearance reduces the addition and does not remove it, because the recall report still stands on the record.

*The vehicle has a verified recall clearance but no open recall fault report at all.* The third clause governs and 0 photographs are added, the addition turning on a recall report standing rather than on a clearance being absent.

*The vehicle has three open recall fault reports and no clearance.* The first clause governs and 3 photographs are added: the clause turns on at least one such report standing, not on how many.
